name: single-adjudicator-variance
whyThisM: 20 runs. For a function proved pure by reading it, M>=2 is the proof and the rest are the same proof again; 20 clean runs bound an unseen per-run divergence rate at only ~15% (rule of three). The inspection is the evidence here, not the count, and reporting the count as the evidence would overstate it.
batchProvenance: every open issue on hornjason/pai-harness at 2026-10-23T14:09:54.369Z, read through `openFindings` (the gate's own reader, capped at OPEN_ISSUE_LIMIT), each replayed as a fresh filing against the set with its own row held out, plus three plants.
caveat: The pinned arm's zero is zero BY CONSTRUCTION — `adjudicateFiling` is regex plus set arithmetic, with no clock, no randomness, no network and no model. Read it as a control establishing that the deterministic half contributes no variance, never as evidence that a quorum has nothing to fix. And the live arm's zero is bounded by its span (31.3s): M reads taken back to back cannot catch a tracker that moves on the scale of tens of minutes, so `distinctTrackerSets: 1` here is a control on the API read and NOT a measurement of tracker drift. Measuring that needs an hours-long window, which is a separate capture and was not taken — deliberately, because a window that long would likely straddle a merge to `lib/issue-filing-gate.ts` and measure a mixture.
permanentlyUnmeasured: There is no deployed agent verifier. `arbitrate` has no caller outside lib/ and test/, and only `scripts/arbitrate-finding.ts` can supply `--votes`. The single-AGENT control the quorum is a variance control FOR has never been read, and is not read here.

A withheld candidate leaves no trace on either arm. It is never filed, never commented on and never fixed, so nothing downstream records whether withholding it was right. `outcomes.ts` derives from commits and the reference graph; a candidate that reached neither is invisible to it, permanently.
A finding nobody ever acted on leaves no trace either — the same hole from the other side. There is no artefact to read, so this is not a measurement that is merely expensive.
